description: This source file defines functions related to launching and managing text editors within a version control context, including selecting appropriate editors based on environment variables and terminal capabilities, and editing files interactively.

methods.name: int is_terminal_dumb(void)
methods.description: Checks if the terminal is a 'dumb' terminal based on the TERM environment variable.

methods.name: const char * git_editor(void)
methods.description: Determines the editor to use based on environment variables and default settings.

methods.name: const char * git_sequence_editor(void)
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence editor command, checking environment and repository config.

methods.name: int launch_specified_editor(const char * editor,const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches a specified editor for a given file path, handling terminal considerations and capturing output.

methods.name: int launch_editor(const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches the default editor for a file, using environment settings.

methods.name: int launch_sequence_editor(const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches the sequence editor, similar to launch_editor but for sequence editing.

methods.name: int strbuf_edit_interactively(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * path,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Allows interactive editing of a buffer content with an external editor, handling file I/O and cleanup.
